### MotionCoordinates { #motion-kt-motioncoordinates }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">MotionCoordinates</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">sourceUnits</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">&quot;m&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">sourceHandedness</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">&quot;right&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">sourceUp</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">&quot;+Y&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">sourceForward</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">String</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s">&quot;+Z&quot;</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">sourceToField</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">List</span><span class="p">&lt;</span><span class="nc">Double</span><span class="p">&gt;</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nf">listOf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">metresPerUnit</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Double</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">)</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/animation/mocap/Motion/#L22)

Motion uses metres, seconds, right handed Y-up coordinates and xyzw quaternions. This matches Field's glTF scene coordinates. Cameras and projection remain the caller's. `sourceToField` is a row-major orthogonal basis, also used for forces; moments are axial vectors.

### MotionBackend { #motionsession-kt-motionbackend }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">interface</span> <span class="nc">MotionBackend</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">AutoCloseable</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/animation/mocap/MotionSession/#L25)

Blocking backend boundary, invoked only by MotionSession's owned daemon thread. Implementations must return bounded batches, honor explicit session times, and close promptly. An installed Python package alone must never advertise a working capability.

### MotionSession { #motionsession-kt-motionsession }

[<code class="highlight"><span class="k">class</span> <span class="nf">MotionSession</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="k">private</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">backend</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">MotionBackend</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">queueCapacity</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">Int</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">32</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="k">val</span> <span class="n">buffer</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">MotionBuffer</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nc">MotionBuffer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="p">:</span> <span class="nc">AutoCloseable</span></code>](source/jvmMain/afield/animation/mocap/MotionSession/#L39)

One small optional motion facade. No inference or simulator work runs on Field's frame thread. Commands are bounded; path/target replacements coalesce only before the next ordered event. Subscriptions run on the worker thread and must be short; rendering reads `buffer` snapshots. Construction in a box registers with its existing RunScope (stop/re-run/document close). Live ARDY/CLoSD drivers require separately validated model environments; `replay` needs neither.
